title: Chesapeake Bay Bridge Tunnel | Eastern Shore Virginia | Night Timelapse in 4K
description:
4 years after my first video, I went back to record another timelapse driving video on the iconic Chesapeake Bay Bridge Tunnel connecting Virginia Beach, VA and Eastern Shore, VA. This is filmed on the westbound side of the bridge at about 6:30 pm on January 8th, 2017. As you can see, there is still snow on the ground and on the sides of the bridge. 

Thanks to NoCopyrightSounds for the music for the second time!

Music: Linked by Jim Yosef and Anna Yvette
